flow.prompt: Candid documentary style, natural and understated. Close overhead view of a dark green velvet cloth on a wooden table in a dim Indian home, a warm evening lamp to one side. Only the hands of an Indian woman in her late 30s, with one thin gold bangle, unhurriedly slide three plain dark-backed cards face down into a neat row, side by side with even gaps, then rest at the edge of the cloth. The cards stay face down the whole time and their backs are plain with no pattern. No face visible. Upper third of the frame darker. Slow, steady handheld camera. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no screens anywhere. No sparkle, no glow. No music, no speech, only soft room sound.
